<MethodEndpoint

</MethodEndpoint>



Microservices-only AutoPay subscription-management proxy. Connect terminates merchant authentication using private API key, Basic auth, or Keycloak JWT, resolves the merchant tenant, forwards the request to AutoPay with Merchant-Id, and returns AutoPay's response body and status to the merchant.

Lists subscriptions using AutoPay's filter-body API. Pagination uses `limit` and `offset`, accepted in the request body or as query parameters (query wins). The returned `next` and `previous` URLs point at this endpoint and can be followed directly.
**Why a POST.** The filters travel in the request body so a `customer_id` never lands in a URL or an access log. The call only reads.

**Paging.** `next` and `previous` are absolute URLs on your own Connect domain, with `limit` and `offset` in their query string. Three rules follow:

1. Follow them with `POST`, the same verb, headers and API key as the first page. A `GET` returns `405 {"detail": "Method \"GET\" not allowed."}`.
2. The body is optional when you follow a link: `POST` the `next` URL with `{}` and you get the right page. Resend your filters in the body to keep them applied.
3. When the query string and the body both carry `limit` or `offset`, the query string wins. The other filters are read from the body only.

Each item is a summary. Call [Retrieve a subscription](/developers/apis/autopay-subscription-detail/) for the card and the latest billing cycle.


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/' \\\n--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY' \\\n--data '{\n  \"status\": \"string\",\n  \"customer_id\": \"string\",\n  \"created_after\": \"2024-07-29\",\n  \"created_before\": \"2024-07-29\",\n  \"limit\": 0,\n  \"offset\": 0\n}'"}</pre>
